scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @yozigo/api" "npm run dev -w @yozigo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @yozigo/api && npm run build -w @yozigo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @yozigo/api && npx vitest run apps/web/src/auth-client.test.ts apps/web/src/movie-client.test.ts apps/web/src/seat-client.test.ts apps/web/src/hold-client.test.ts
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @yozigo/api && npm run lint -w @yozigo/web
